en_title: Xbox Speaks Out After Double Fine Lays Off 25 Percent of Staff in Transition to Independent Status
subtitle: 保留IP和目录
opus_summary: 《意航员》开发商Double Fine重归独立后裁员约25.6%。XBOX称工作室保留IP、作品目录及后续游戏资源；约90人的团队正缩减至独立运营能承受的规模。

paragraphs.en: Double Fine, best known for creating the 2005 platform game Psychonauts, has laid off 25.6% of its staff three weeks after Xbox’s massive restructuring efforts were revealed.
paragraphs.cn: 以2005年平台游戏《意航员》闻名的Double Fine，在XBOX大规模重组消息披露三周后裁掉了25.6%的员工。

paragraphs.en: The studio announced the layoffs on July 28, 2026, confirming that this downsizing was a direct result of becoming an independent company after Xbox unloaded them as part of its own restructuring earlier this month.
paragraphs.cn: 该工作室于2026年7月28日宣布裁员，并确认这次缩编直接源于本月早些时候XBOX在自身重组中剥离该工作室、使其成为独立公司的决定。

paragraphs.en: “As a small, tightly-knit team, these actions are not taken lightly,” a statement from Double Fine reads. “Only the survival of our studio would ever make us consider such a painful action. Our transition to becoming an independent company also means becoming a size that we can sustain. The people we are losing were all important. They all made an impact on our games and culture, and they will be missed. We are committed to supporting each affected person as best as we can, and we thank them for their hard work and commitment to the creative spirit we cherish here at Double Fine.”
paragraphs.cn: Double Fine在声明中表示：「作为一个规模小、联系紧密的团队，我们并非轻率采取这些行动。只有工作室的生存会让我们考虑如此痛苦的举措。转型为独立公司，也意味着我们必须缩减为能够维持的规模。我们正在失去的每一位员工都很重要。他们都对我们的游戏与文化产生了影响，我们会怀念他们。我们承诺尽己所能支持每位受影响者，并感谢他们的辛勤工作，以及对我们在Double Fine所珍视的创作精神的投入。」

paragraphs.en: Xbox also released a statement about the layoffs, confirming that the studio fully returned to its independent status earlier this week, keeping their “IP, catalog, and runway for their next games.”
paragraphs.cn: XBOX也就裁员发布声明，确认该工作室本周早些时候已完全恢复独立地位，并保留了自己的「IP、作品目录以及开发后续游戏所需的资源」。

paragraphs.en: “As they begin their next chapter as an independent studio, we look forward to seeing what they create next. Double Fine is now fully independent and manages its own operations,” a spokesperson said to Kotaku .
paragraphs.cn: 一位发言人向Kotaku表示：「在他们作为独立工作室开启下一篇章之际，我们期待看到他们接下来会创造什么。Double Fine现已完全独立，并自行管理运营。」

paragraphs.en: As revealed by Jason Schreier, Double Fine is a roughly 90-person team, meaning that around 25.5% of staff was cut as the studio shrinks back to a manageable size to match its independent status.
paragraphs.cn: 据Jason Schreier披露，Double Fine的团队约有90人，这意味着工作室为回缩到与独立地位相符、可管理的规模，裁掉了约25.5%的员工。

paragraphs.en: Double Fine’s self-management, as well as that of Compulsion Games (We Happy Few, South of Midnight), was revealed earlier this month. Both studios got to keep their IPs in the transition, with each thanking fans for their continued support and promising to share updates on future projects at a later date.
paragraphs.cn: 本月早些时候，Double Fine以及Compulsion Games（《We Happy Few》《午夜之南》）的自主管理安排已被披露。两家工作室都在转型中保留了各自的IP；双方均感谢粉丝持续支持，并承诺日后分享未来项目的更新。

paragraphs.en: This isn’t the first time either development house has been independent; in fact, both were founded as indie studios at the start, with Double Fine famously founded by LucasArts alum Tim Schafer in 2002.
paragraphs.cn: 这并非两家开发商首次独立；实际上，它们起初都以独立工作室的身份成立。Double Fine则由LucasArts前员工Tim Schafer于2002年创立，这一点尤其广为人知。

paragraphs.en: On July 6, 2026, Xbox CEO Asha Sharma sent out an internal email to staff announcing the most “significant” restructuring in the company’s history that would impact thousands of employees. 3,200 were on the chopping block, with 1,600 laid off that day. As noted by IGN’s Wesley Yin-Poole, this means about one-fifth of its staff will be impacted, as well as numerous studios Xbox purchased during its infamous buying spree over the last five years.
paragraphs.cn: 2026年7月6日，XBOX CEO Asha Sharma向员工发出内部邮件，宣布公司历史上最「重大的」一次重组，将影响数千名员工。3,200人面临裁撤，其中1,600人在当天被裁。正如IGN的Wesley Yin-Poole所指出的，这意味着约五分之一员工会受影响，XBOX过去五年臭名昭著的收购狂潮中买下的许多工作室也同样如此。

paragraphs.en: “I want Xbox to be one of the few companies that entertains more than a billion people each day and gives everyone the opportunity to create and connect,” Sharma wrote in her email. “I know we can achieve this goal. XBOX has many of the most beloved franchises in entertainment history, talented studios around the world, and we will return to growth in 2027.
paragraphs.cn: Sharma在邮件中写道：「我希望XBOX成为少数每天能娱乐超过10亿人、并让每个人都有机会创作和交流的公司之一。我知道我们能够实现这个目标。XBOX拥有娱乐史上许多最受喜爱的系列、遍布全球的优秀工作室，我们将在2027年重回增长。」

paragraphs.en: “History is full of companies that mistake longevity for inevitability. We will not be one of them.”
paragraphs.cn: 「历史上不乏把长久存续误当成必然的公司。我们不会成为其中之一。」
